## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss trading platforms and share insights on respective projects](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=0.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [Adrian is developing a trading journal for options traders, focusing on emotional tracking and planning/execution mirroring](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=150.0)
  - [Valentyn is building an AI-powered chat assistant for crypto traders, aiming to reduce emotional trading through data-driven insights](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=591.0)
  - [Both are in MVP stages, with Adrian partnering with an options trading educator and Valentyn preparing for initial B2C and B2B outreach](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=474.0)
  - [Shared tech stack similarities (e.g., Supabase) and exchanged tips on analytics tools and AI integration](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1006.0)

## Topics

### Adrian's Trading Journal Project

  - [Focused on options trading, allowing traders to document trades and emotional states](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=150.0)
  - [Features include trade logging, statistics, emotion tracking, and checklists](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=241.0)
  - [Partnering with an options trading educator to onboard users and gather feedback](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=480.0)
  - [Tech stack: Supabase for backend, Next.js for frontend](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1063.0)
  - [Lesson learned: Release early to test product-market fit, avoid over-engineering](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1941.0)

### Valentyn's AI Chat Assistant for Crypto Traders

  - [Targets Gen Z and young crypto traders initially, with plans to expand](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=828.0)
  - [Connects multiple data sources and uses AI to provide insights and reduce emotional trading](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=625.0)
  - [Deployed on Azure with .NET backend, planning Telegram integration](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1038.0)
  - [Aims to offer B2B solutions in the future, allowing businesses to integrate the assistant into their platforms](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=947.0)

### Tech Stack and Development Insights

  - [Both use Supabase; Adrian's backend is simpler, while Valentyn's is more complex due to multiple data sources](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1063.0)
  - [Discussed deployment challenges and shared code snippets for waitlist implementation](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1123.0)
  - [Adrian recommended PostHog for analytics, highlighting its comprehensive features and ease of use](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1611.0)
  - [Valentyn suggested exploring MCP (Modular Cognitive Patterns) for AI enhancements in Adrian's project](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1821.0)

### Product Development Strategies

  - [Emphasis on releasing MVP quickly to gather user feedback and avoid over-engineering](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1941.0)
  - [Discussed the importance of simplicity in backend development for easier maintenance](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1869.0)
  - [Shared experiences on the challenges of perfecting landing pages and the need to launch despite imperfections](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1941.0)

## Next Steps

  - [Valentyn to deploy his waitlist page and connect Supabase](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1123.0)
  - [Adrian to share waitlist code and SQL for database setup with Valentyn](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=2074.0)
  - [Both to consider each other's suggestions (PostHog for Valentyn, MCP for Adrian)](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1821.0)
  - [Continue development with a focus on releasing MVPs quickly and gathering user feedback](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1941.0)
  - [Maintain contact for potential future collaborations and knowledge sharing](https://fathom.video/share/i5W7tG63zqqN2CCMVE_dPKt1hBd5dsT7?tab=summary&timestamp=1926.0)
